name: io.github.cyanheads/oecd-mcp-server
description: Search and query 1,500+ OECD statistical datasets via SDMX. Keyless.

tools.name: oecd_list_agencies
tools.description: List OECD SDMX agencies, the directorate each belongs to, and the number of dataflows each publishes. Use to discover agency IDs before filtering oecd_search_datasets by department.

tools.name: oecd_search_datasets
tools.description: Search OECD dataflows by keyword or theme, or omit query to list every dataflow in catalog order (optionally scoped to one agency_id). When query is supplied, each whitespace-separated token must match at the start of a word in dataflow names or descriptions, with name matches ranked first. Returns flow_ref identifiers, names, and agency IDs for use with oecd_get_dataset_info.

query.description: Optional keyword or phrase to search for in dataflow names and descriptions — e.g. "GDP", "house prices", "TiVA". Omit or leave blank to list every dataflow in catalog order (all agencies, or only agency_id when set). Every whitespace-separated token must start a word in the name or description, ignoring case: "price" matches "Prices" and "tiva" matches "(TiVA)", but "tiva" does not match "activation". A word starts after any character that is not a letter or digit, or at a lowercase-to-uppercase step ("markers" matches "RioMarkers"). A token that opens on such a character, like "&" or "-oecd", matches anywhere it occurs: "&" finds "R&D".

agency_id.description: Optional agency identifier to restrict the search or listing scope — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD". Omit query with agency_id to list every dataflow published by that agency. Obtain valid agency IDs from oecd_list_agencies.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20; a larger value returns at most 2,000 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first dataflow to return within the ranked match list (or catalog order when query is omitted or blank), applied before limit. Page through results past the limit by advancing it; an offset at or past total_matches returns an empty list.

tools.name: oecd_get_dataset_info
tools.description: Fetch a dataflow's metadata (name, full description, linked resources), dimensions, their order, and how to construct a query key. Returns per-dimension names, codelist references, and position in the dot-delimited key. Required before calling oecd_query_dataset to understand key structure.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference, either {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id} — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I" — or the bare {agencyID},{df_id} form OECD uses for the few dataflows published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets.

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

tools.name: oecd_get_dimension_values
tools.description: Fetch the valid codes and labels for one dimension of a dataflow, including each code's parent ID in hierarchical codelists. Use to resolve human-readable names (countries, measures) to SDMX codes before querying with oecd_query_dataset. Pass parent to list direct children of one parent code, or query to match a code or label by substring — codelists run to a thousand-plus entries, and the response is a page of at most limit codes either way. A codelist is shared across dataflows and can list codes this one holds no data for: pass available_only to list only the codes with data, or key to list the codes with data given the key's other segments — a structure read, never a data download.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I", or the bare "OECD.TAD.ARP,DF_AEI2024_DASHBOARD" form for a dataflow published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets.

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

dimension_id.description: Dimension identifier to fetch codes for — e.g. "REF_AREA" or "MEASURE". Obtain valid dimension IDs from oecd_get_dataset_info.

parent.description: Filter to codes whose parent code equals this value (exact case-sensitive code match, e.g. "FRA" for France's TL2 regions). Applied after available_only and key, and before query, offset, and limit. Omit to include codes at all hierarchy levels.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against both the code and its label, so "PA" and "percent" each reach the code "PA" / "Percent per annum". Applied after available_only, key, and parent. Omit to page the full matching list.

available_only.description: List only the codes of this dimension that have data in this dataflow, from OECD's availability record, with the time_range and observation_count they cover. Applied before parent, query, offset, and limit. Default false: the whole codelist.

key.description: Dot-delimited key in the oecd_query_dataset form, one segment per dimension in the order oecd_get_dataset_info gives — empty for a wildcard, "+" between codes, or "all". Lists the codes of this dimension that have data given the key's other segments, so pass the key you plan to query. Implies available_only.

start_period.description: Inclusive lower SDMX period bound, e.g. "2024" or "2024-Q1". A nonblank value implies available_only.

end_period.description: Inclusive upper SDMX period bound, e.g. "2024" or "2024-Q4". A nonblank value implies available_only.

limit.description: Maximum codes to return. Default 50; a larger value returns at most 10,000 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first code to return within the matching list, applied before limit. Advance it to page; an offset past the last match returns an empty page.

tools.name: oecd_query_dataset
tools.description: Fetch observations from an OECD dataflow filtered by a dimension key, optional time range, and optional last_n_observations. Returns one row per observation, sorted by dimension code and then period, carrying the dimensions and attributes that vary — each label with its SDMX code beside it as <ID>_code — and values already scaled by the unit multiplier; the components holding one value across the whole result come back once, in constant_columns. Large multi-country time-series spill to a DataCanvas table holding every column, codes included, returning a preview head of up to 25 rows — inspect columns with oecd_dataframe_describe, then query the full table with SQL using oecd_dataframe_query; without DataCanvas every row comes back inline on both surfaces. Call oecd_get_dataset_info first to learn the dimension order for constructing the key.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I", or the bare "OECD.TAD.ARP,DF_AEI2024_DASHBOARD" form for a dataflow published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets and pass it through unchanged.

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

key.description: Dot-delimited dimension key matching the dimension order from oecd_get_dataset_info. Empty segments are wildcards; "+" separates multiple values per segment. Example: "A.USA+DEU.B1GQ.." — Annual, USA or Germany, GDP, all remaining dimensions.

start_period.description: Start of the time range — ISO period code such as "2010", "2010-Q1", or "2010-01". Omit to include all history (may produce very large results).

end_period.description: End of the time range — ISO period code such as "2023" or "2023-Q4". Omit to include up to the latest available period.

last_n_observations.description: Return only the most recent N observations per series (SDMX lastNObservations). OECD applies lastNObservations to each series before start_period / end_period, so setting end_period before a series’s latest N periods excludes those observations. Omit end_period when asking for the latest N observations. A larger value is capped at 100,000 and the response reports the reduction.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from a prior oecd_query_dataset call — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores — to stage this result alongside that one if it spills; a result that fits inline comes back inline and leaves that canvas unchanged. Omit to let the server mint a canvas if this result needs one; a canvas_id comes back only when the result was large enough to spill.

tools.name: oecd_dataframe_describe
tools.description: List tables and columns staged on a DataCanvas by a prior oecd_query_dataset spill. Call this before oecd_dataframe_query to discover exact table and column names for SQL. Unavailable when the server runs with DataCanvas disabled.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by oecd_query_dataset — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Identifies the DataCanvas session holding the staged observation tables.

tools.name: oecd_dataframe_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against OECD observation tables staged on a DataCanvas by oecd_query_dataset. Call oecd_dataframe_describe first to discover exact table and column names, then use this tool for aggregation, filtering, GROUP BY, JOIN, and window functions. Returns up to `limit` rows (default 100, at most 1,000 per call); truncated: true marks a result with more rows than came back, and its notice says how to reach the rest. A query still running after 30 seconds is stopped. Unavailable when the server runs with DataCanvas disabled.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by oecd_query_dataset — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Identifies the DataCanvas session holding the observation tables.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT statement. Reference tables by the names returned by oecd_dataframe_describe. Only SELECT statements are allowed — DDL, DML, and file-reading functions are rejected.

limit.description: Most rows to return; for more than one call returns, aggregate in SQL or page with ORDER BY … LIMIT … OFFSET. Default 100; a larger value returns at most 1,000 and says so.
